name: True North Schooner 2-8 Person Outdoor Barrel Sauna
description: Description This beautiful barrel sauna is handmade in Ontario, Canada. It has been developed for outdoor use in nature and can withstand any weather. It is available in various lengths. You can select an optional porch for the sauna: 9' and 10' models come with a 2' porch option, while 6' and 8' models have a 1' porch option. (Note: The porch decreases the inside length.) Different window options are available and you can choose if you want a wood stove or an electric heater inside. The sauna comes as a kit that requires assembly . Features: 2 wood options: White Cedar- slightly stronger and almost as resistant to rot and decay as red cedar, and has a beautiful light-colored finish. Red Cedar- naturally weather and insect-resistant, gives off a pleasant and recognizable scent and is aesthetically attractive. Comes standard with roof membrane & 2nd layer of roof boards Fascia boards to protect the end grain of the barrel wood 2 premium benches for sitting and reclining Partially pre-assembled construction with built-in venting holes Also Includes: 3 peg towel hanger, Vent kit, and cover, Screws for assembly, Flat floor , Door handles, Glassdoor, Benches Optional front and rear windows Optional porch which decreases inside space accordingly. The total length remains the same. Specifications Seats: 6' (2-4 people), 8' (4-6 people), 9' (6-8 people), 10' (6-8 people) Interior Volume (cu ft): 170 (6′ long) / 141 (6’ w/ 1’ Porch) 226 (8′ long) / 198 (8’ w/ 1’ Porch) 254 (9′ long) / 198 (9’ w/ 2’ Porch) 283 (10′ long) / 226 (10’ w/ 2’ Porch) Dimensions: 72” long x 90” wide x 80” tall (6’ long) 96” long x 90” wide x 80” tall (8’ long) 108” long x 90” wide x 80” tall (9’ long) 120” long x 90” wide x 80” tall (10’ long) Bench Lengths: 65.5” (6’)/ 53.5” (6’ w/ 1’ Porch) 89.5” (8’)/ 77.5” (8’ w/ 1’ Porch) 101.5” (9’)/ 77.5” (9’ w/ 2’ Porch) 113.5” (10’)/ 89.5” (10’ w/ 2’ Porch) Height: 6.6ft (outside), 6.3 ft (inside) Wood: White Cedar or Red Cedar Walls: 1.55" thick solid wood Door: Wood-framed glass Made in: Canada Assembly Assembly Guide
